rule.name: SpringStaticPostProcessorBean
rule.message: Make this @Bean method static and give it only Environment or ObjectProvider parameters. A post-processor or @ConfigurationPropertiesBinding bean is created before post-processing is ready, so an instance method creates its configuration class, and each parameter its bean, too early; those beans then miss proxies such as @Transactional and @Async.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')]] [ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanPostProcessor') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.config.BeanFactoryPostProcessor')] or ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationPropertiesBinding')]] [not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static') or FormalParameters/FormalParameter [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Lazy') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value')])] [not(*[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.core.env.Environment') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanFactory') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext')])]]
